visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a woman in a gold sequined top holding up three gold-packaged Dolce & Gabbana makeup items against a neutral white wall. She smiles enthusiastically, her facial expressions high in arousal. (2) Chronological cuts show close-ups of the luxury packaging: a cream-colored foundation bottle with a gold heart emblem, a black leather-textured cushion compact with a prominent gold 'DG' logo, and a gold lipstick tube also adorned with a heart. (3) The woman proceeds to test the foundation on one half of her face, using a small mirror and her fingers to spread the product. The screen is split with text labels to differentiate the sides. (4) She then demonstrates the cushion compact on the other half of her face, tapping the puff onto her cheek and showing the skin's finish under bright studio lighting. (5) She transitions to applying a reddish-orange lip mud, showing a close-up of the applicator and her lips as the texture changes from liquid to a matte film. (6) The video concludes with her winking and holding all three products near her face, showcasing the final full-makeup look.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio track opens with a high-pitched, enthusiastic female voice shouting 'Dolce & Gabbana' over a rhythmic electronic BGM. A 'whoosh' SFX signals the start. (2) As products are presented, percussive 'ding' sounds and cartoonish 'pop' effects occur in sync with camera cuts. The speaker's tone is extremely high-arousal and fast-paced. (3) During the foundation demonstration, the speaker provides a detailed explanation of the product's coverage, accompanied by a steady, upbeat synth-pop track. Brief rustling sounds of makeup packaging are audible. (4) The audio transitions to the cushion compact section with a playful 'bell' chime. The voice shifts to a slightly more inquisitive but still positive pitch. (5) In the lipstick phase, the sound of the applicator clicking and subtle lip smacking sounds are heard, mixed with comical SFX when the speaker reacts to the color. (6) The final section features a summarized closing statement with high vocal dominance and a swelling BGM volume that concludes with a decisive 'hard cut' sound.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Product Intro -> Feature Test (Foundation) -> Feature Test (Cushion) -> Feature Test (Lipstick) -> Comparison Summary -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To provide a comprehensive, energetic review and comparison of Dolce & Gabbana makeup products, highlighting their physical design, skin finish, and long-wear properties for a beauty-conscious audience.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Detailed display of luxury brand logos, specific product shades, and a highly positive review of quality and aesthetics.
